name: playwright
description: Write, review, and debug end-to-end (E2E) tests with Playwright Test, including new suites, configuration, and migration. Use when Playwright is requested or discovered and the work involves browser test authoring, specs, runner configuration, projects, fixtures, authentication or storage state, locators, waiting, network routing, browser isolation, traces or media, parallelism, sharding, failures, or upgrades. Detect the installed version before version-sensitive guidance. Use test for test strategy, agent-browser for one-off browser automation, and framework specialists for framework rendering and routing contracts.
